items.title: Make the doctor global-core-realpath check linked-worktree-aware
items.context: checkGlobalCoreRealpath (packages/main/src/core/runtime-environment-checks.ts:223-245, surfaced via handlers/doctor.ts): the non-self-project branch compares the global @lattice/core realpath against the running CLI's own corePackageRoot without canonicalization, so a worktree-built CLI evaluating a fixture/temp project always warns (expected=.worktrees/B-xxxx/packages/main vs global=canonical main checkout). Fix: canonicalize the non-self expected via the repository containing corePackageRoot (git worktree list anchored at corePackageRoot, mirroring resolveCanonicalSelfCoreRoot lines 755-777); keep the genuine unrelated-path warn. Regression tests: worktree-built-CLI + fixture context passes with no warn and doctor brief returns under the 20000-byte brief-output-smoke budget; a genuinely mismatched global path still warns. Acceptance signal: npm test green from inside a story worktree.
